name: Low-commission niche storefront and marketplace for fee-squeezed Etsy sellers
buyer: Small craft, vintage or pattern sellers whose margin is squeezed by Etsy fees and policy tightening
pain: Stacked fees, mandatory offsite ads for sellers above $10K, and policy tightening that orphans some listings.
wedge: A flat 5-8% all-in take rate for one orphaned niche, such as vintage digital ephemera, with SEO-led catalog pages to bring buyers.

scan1Edge.entrant_basis: A flat take rate of ~6.5% all-in. The incumbent ~10% on a $50 sale is from the notes; the excerpt's table is truncated.
scan1Edge.falsifier: If the entrant cannot bring buyer traffic comparable to what sellers get from Etsy, the lower fee is irrelevant because net revenue to sellers falls.
scan1Edge.unit: percent of sale price taken in fees (base fees, no ads)

substitutesNoted.name: Etsy
substitutesNoted.price_point: ~10% base fees on a $50 sale; 12-15% Offsite Ads where applicable

unitEconomicsNoted.notes: ESTIMATE from the notes: 50-70% margin on a tiny gross merchandise value. Payment processing cost is not netted out.

majorUncertainty: Chicken-and-egg: no buyer traffic means no reason for sellers to move, regardless of fee level.
unknowns: Marketplace-facilitator sales-tax obligations in relevant states
Whether orphaned vintage-digital sellers exist in meaningful numbers
Buyer SEO acquisition cost for the niche
Stripe Connect terms for a marketplace
Total all-in Etsy cost percentage (22-26% in the notes) is truncated in the excerpts
regulatoryOrPlatformDependency: Payments through Stripe Connect or similar. Marketplace-facilitator sales-tax collection may apply (not verified).
